A '''battle''' between [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] took place sometime after the [[Exiles]]' [[discovery of Korriban]] and the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]].<ref name="JvS" />

After the Exiles found the Sith species and became their [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]], several of them took the ship they had arrived on and used it to retrace their path to [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith space]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="JvS" />

They took with them several [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors, weapons and their new found secrets in [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] in an attempt to destroy the Jedi against the orders and will of their leader, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Ajunta Pall]].<ref name="JvS" />

The battle resulted in their destruction and the Jedi learning of Sith space. After the Jedi attacked the Sith. Pall would later use the story as a lesson against too much ambition.<ref name="JvS" />
